subject: Supplemental control evidence & bridge period clarification — MedNova
content:
From: Alicia Park <apark@mednova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: MedNova Security <security@mednova.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA rotation, privileged deprovisioning)

Irene,

Thanks for the Type II we received last week — that was helpful. Our audit team has a couple of follow-ups specific to internal controls that need supplemental artifacts beyond the report itself:

- MFA rotation/verification: sample slices showing MFA enforcement and any rotation/verification activities for the audit window (2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31).
- Privileged account deprovisioning: timeline of deprovisioning actions and privileged access review evidence for service accounts and admin users.
- Authn/log slices: 3–5 day sample (UTC) of authn events correlated to MFA success/failure and session creation.

Can you confirm Redwood can provide a bridge letter for a limited gap (if any) for the requested slices, and whether you can provide the authn extract in CSV format? Also include preferred retention/handling instructions for the sample extracts.

Appreciate a short plan and estimated delivery dates so we can slot this into our auditor timeline.

Regards,
Alicia Park
Senior Security Analyst
MedNova Health
apark@mednova.com

---

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <apark@mednova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA rotation, privileged deprovisioning)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. Internal plan below and a few clarifying questions. We can provide the supplemental artifacts you listed; here is our suggested approach: 

1) Bridge letter / audit window.
   - We will confirm whether any data gaps exist for the exact audit window (2026-10-01 — 2027-03-31) and prepare a bridge letter describing the scope of available artifacts and any compensating controls.
   - Draft delivery: bridge-letter-draft.docx (attached).

2) MFA rotation/verification slices.
   - We can extract rotation events and admin changes tied to MFA policies. We propose a focused sample of rotation/change events (CSV) covering: user id, timestamp (UTC), change type, initiating actor, verification status.
   - Estimated delivery: 5 business days after you confirm the exact number of user samples you want (we recommend 50 users or a cross-section of privileged vs non-privileged accounts).

3) Privileged deprovisioning evidence.
   - We'll provide an access review report and a timeline of deprovisioning actions for service accounts (audit entries + change request IDs). If you need screenshots from our console or ticket references, we can include those.

4) Authn/log slices.
   - We normally provide a 72-hour UTC slice in CSV with obfuscated PII where appropriate and a mapping file for event types. We can also include a short README with extraction filters.

Questions:
- Do your auditors require raw log lines or a parsed CSV?
- Confirm any specific user IDs or target systems you want prioritized (examples: admin.redwood.internal, deployment-sa@redwood).
- Any additional controls (keystore rotation, privileged session recordings) you need evidence for?

I'll loop in Karthik to confirm the extraction plan and Sean for any privileged access artifacts. If that all looks good we will lock the delivery dates.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <apark@mednova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA rotation, privileged deprovisioning)

Alicia / Irene — quick technical notes on the extraction cadence and format:

- Authn slices: we will produce CSV exports (UTC timestamps) with the following fields: event_ts, user_email_hash, event_type, mfa_factor, mfa_result, session_id, source_ip, service_tag. We will pseudonymize user emails (hash) unless you require cleartext IDs under an NDA.
- MFA rotation: rotation events are tracked in our IAM change log and include a rotation_token id and admin actor; we'll pull the event bundle and include cross-references to our ticketing system for each rotation.
- Privileged deprovisioning: for service accounts we will include the deprovision ticket id, change timestamp, and before/after role bindings.

Delivery estimates (after Alicia confirms sample scope):
- Authn 72-hour CSV slice + README: 3 business days
- MFA rotation sample CSV: 5 business days
- Privileged deprovisioning package (CSV + ticket links + console screenshots): 7 business days

We will encrypt the deliverables with customer-managed key (or our transient key if you prefer). Please confirm preferred transfer method (S3 presigned link with expiry, secure Share, or an encrypted Drive share).

-Karthik
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alicia Park <apark@mednova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, MedNova Security <security@mednova.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA rotation, privileged deprovisioning)

Irene / Karthik — this is great, thank you. Quick answers:
- Auditors prefer parsed CSVs (tidy columns) but can handle raw logs if accompanied by parsing notes. CSVs are preferred.
- We'll prioritize 50 user samples for MFA rotation (include 10 privileged accounts) and the 72-hour authn slice for the calendar week that includes 2027-02-14 (UTC).
- Transfer method: S3 presigned (7 day expiry) with AES-256 encryption is our default. If you can encrypt with a customer-managed key, that would be ideal.

Can you confirm by EOD Friday (2027-09-03) with the final delivery dates so we can lock with our auditors? Also appreciate the bridge letter draft — we'll review and send comments.

Best,
Alicia

Attachments referenced: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II), authn-log-sample-instructions.txt, bridge-letter-draft.docx
